kid.estimator: Unbiased polynomial MMD squared, averaged across 50 fixed subsets
kid.preprocessing: Clamp images to [-1,1], quantize to 8-bit using the historical display transform, then extract features.
kid.uncertainty_note: Subset mean/std describe the metric calculation; they are not training-seed averages or confidence intervals.

lowpass_swd.features: Adaptive average pooling to 8x8 RGB, flattened to 192 dimensions
lowpass_swd.estimator: Mean absolute difference of projected quantiles, a sliced-W1 approximation

patch_swd.features: Nonoverlapping 4x4 RGB patches, flattened to 48 dimensions
patch_swd.estimator: Mean absolute difference of projected quantiles, a sliced-W1 approximation

statistics_preprocessing.raw: Original floating-point image values without clipping
statistics_preprocessing.clamp: Both generated and reference values clamped to [-1,1]
statistics_preprocessing.display8bit: Both sets pass through the same clamp/8-bit display transform and are mapped back to [-1,1]

relative_reduction_percent: 100 * (control_value - candidate_value) / control_value; positive means lower distance.
scope: Pixel-statistics diagnostics are not FID, semantic accuracy or direct perceptual sharpness.

quality_implementation.path_scope: original experiment archive, relative to its workspace root

statistics_implementation.path_scope: original experiment archive, relative to its workspace root
